P.name: Threads of Vibration
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Skarner's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}}, ''{{ai|Shattered Earth|Skarner}}'', ''{{ai|Upheaval|Skarner}}'', and ''{{ai|Impale|Skarner}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Quaking'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. Enemies afflicted with 3 stacks take {{as|magic damage}} equal to {{ft|{{as|{{pp|5 + (9-5)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%|defaultDisplayMaxLevel=true}} of their '''maximum''' health}} over the duration, capped at {{pp|100 + (300-100)/17*(x-1) for 20|defaultDisplayMaxLevel=true}} against {{tip|monsters}}.|{{as|{{pp|5*0.125 + (9*0.125-5*0.125)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%|round=3|defaultDisplayMaxLevel=true}} of their '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration, capped at {{pp|100/8 + (300/8-100/8)/17*(x-1) for 20|defaultDisplayMaxLevel=true}} per tick against {{tip|monsters}}.}}

Q.name: Shattered Earth
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' rips a boulder from the ground, empowering up to three of his next {{tip|basic attacks}} within 5 seconds of each other. These attacks gain {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the target and surrounding enemies, including {{tip|structures}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 3% of his '''bonus''' health)}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10*3 to 50*3}} {{as|(+{{ap|90*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*3}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
Q.description2: The final attack slams the boulder, dealing an additional {{as|11% of each target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} afflicted enemies by 40% for 1 second. The additional damage is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}} and is not applied against structures.
Q.description3: After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the cast, '''Skarner''' gains the ability to use ''Upheaval'' during ''Shattered Earth''.
Q.description4: ''Casting Shattered Earth {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Skarner's''' basic attack timer. Shattered Earth's duration is paused during {{ai|Ixtal's Impact|Skarner}}.''

Q.name: Upheaval
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' ends ''{{ai|Shattered Earth|Skarner}}'' by throwing his boulder in the target direction. It explodes upon colliding with the first enemy hit, applying the same damage and slow to the target and surrounding enemies as ''Shattered Earth's'' final empowered attack would.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 3% of his '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|(+ 11% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Maximum Monster Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 3% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
Q.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Normal cast}}|{{tt|none|When cast automatically from Impale's cast}}}}

W.name: Seismic Bastion
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' slams his claws into the ground, {{tip|shield|shielding}} himself equal to {{as|8% of his '''maximum''' health}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and releasing a shockwave that {{tt|quickly|~0.25 seconds}} expands in a radius around him to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow}} them by 20% for 1 second.
W.description2: '''''Skarner''' can move during Seismic Bastion's cast time.''

E.name: Ixtal's Impact
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' charges forward in the direction of the cursor for up to {{fd|2.75}} seconds, during which he gains {{tip|slow immunity}}, becomes {{tip|ghosted}}, ignores [[terrain]]  collision, and has {{tip|unobstructed vision}} of the surrounding 650 units. He automatically navigates his movement along the way and is able to steer himself with a slow turn rate that increases over time, resetting upon changing direction. ''Ixtal's Impact'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
E.description2: '''Skarner''' begins the charge at a {{tt|static amount|Cannot be modified by any means}} of {{sti|{{as|150 movement speed}}}} that increases by {{as|100|ms}} every {{rutngt|0.25}}, up to {{as|950 '''total''' movement speed}} by the end of the duration. If '''Skarner''' collides with an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, he grabs them with his claws for the time of the remaining charge, {{tip|attach|attaching}} them to himself, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} them, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them, increasing the charge's turn rate to the maximum, and gaining {{as|300 '''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}, with a minimum total of {{as|650|ms}} and a maximum total of {{as|1150|ms}}. If a target has been grabbed before the first {{fd|1.75}} seconds of the charge, the remaining duration is set to 1 second, and set to {{fd|0.5}} seconds otherwise. The charge does not ramp up in speed while a target is grabbed.
E.description3: If '''Skarner's''' attached target collides with terrain, the charge ends, detaching them from him, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.1}} seconds, and reducing ''Ixtal's Impact's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 35%.
E.leveling3: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 150}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 6% of his '''maximum''' health)}}}}
E.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Skarner''' ends ''Ixtal's Impact''. If a target has been grabbed, he detaches them from himself.
E.description5: ''Ixtal's Impact ends immediately if '''Skarner''' becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}, during the charge. The grabbed target is detached if this occurs. While the target is grabbed, they are attached to '''Skarner''' 200 units in front of him.''

R.name: Impale
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' winds up his stingers over the cast time, then lashes them forward in an isosceles trapezoid in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and impaling up to 3 of the closest enemy champions within the area to {{tip|suppression|suppress}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. While suppressed, the targets are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} and {{tip|attach|attached}} to '''Skarner'''. If he successfully impales at least one enemy champion, '''Skarner''' gains {{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}} for the same duration.
R.description2: ''If Impale is cast during {{ai|Shattered Earth|Skarner}}, '''Skarner''' {{tt|automatically casts|Without incurring Upheaval's cast time}} {{ai|Upheaval|Skarner}} in the direction of Impale's cast. '''Skarner''' is unable to basic attack, cast {{ai|Shattered Earth|Skarner}} or {{ai|Ixtal's Impact|Skarner}}, or use {{si|Flash}} during Impale. While the targets are impaled, they are attached to '''Skarner''' 300 units {{tt|in front of him|In the direction he cast Impale}}. Targets are placed 200 units in the same direction at the end of the effect.''
